turns.text: Yeah, hi. I need to cancel a booking.
I can help with that. First I need your booking code and the last name on the booking.
Thank you, I have your booking. It's Dubai to Paris on SK312, next Sunday at 19:15, in Economy. What would you like to do with it?
I want to cancel it. Can I get the money back on my card?

Refunds to the original card are only for flights we cancelled or for bookings made in the last 24 hours. This booking was made 9 days ago and we did not cancel the flight, so it would become a travel credit. A voluntary cancellation on an Economy fare also carries a $75 fee.
Seventy-five dollars just to cancel. Fine. So I get the rest as credit?
Yes, the fare you paid becomes a travel credit, less the $75 fee. Do you want me to go ahead and cancel SK312 on booking JK4A8E?
Your booking JK4A8E on SK312 is cancelled, with the fare held as a travel credit less the $75 fee.
